recent_events.event: John woke to the Silence. System F-rank awakening complete. Alien ship over Lindenauer Hafen. 3 survivors confirmed in Leipzig district.
3 cataloger entities detached from ship, moved toward Leipzig city centre and Hauptbahnhof. Systematic. Did not approach residential areas.
John packed, braced knee, left flat. On Karl-Heine-Straße — city empty, tram stopped, car running with door open.
John looted Rewe on Industriestraße. Acquired food, weapons (chef's knife, cleaver, bone saw, mop handle staff), Molotov components, CO2 extinguisher.

John climbed church tower on Plagwitzer Straße. Catalogers spotted on Grimmaische Straße — past inner ring road, closer than expected. Lit window spotted at Josephinenstraße 800m NE — possible survivor.
